notes.title: Can you beat the impossible mode Challenge.
notes.content:
[b]Can you beat the impossible mode? [/b]It's the [b]hardest[/b] mode in the game where all the lights are off, the only light is the flashlight. Marny moves faster than you and [b]always knows where you are at,[/b] so even if you hide she would just wait there and once you come out of the hiding spot she would kill you. Beating the impossible requires you to know the exact locations of objects and find a way to not let her catch you. I as the developer have not beaten the impossible mode yet.[b] Become the first one[/b] to beat it and unlock the [b]super rare  Golden Survivor achievement.[/b]

[b]Good luck and be the first one![/b]

notes.title: Bernie's Nightmare Update V6 Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Bernie's Nightmare Update V6 Released![/h1]

What's new?

* Added Steam Achievements.

* Added 2 new difficulty modes: Hard mode and Impossible mode.

* Added Polish translations

* Changes to the map, object placements, and lights.

* Change to background music.

* FIxed bugs.

notes.title: New Update V5 Available!
notes.content:
Bernie's Nightmare Update V5:

Since the release, many Youtubers and testers reported the 2 most common bugs existed in the game, the cross floor death bug, and the keypad bug. So I spent the whole night debugging and fixing the bug, and since I needed to release a patch to fix these bugs anyways, I added some stuff to the game level and a new menu screen font.

What's New:

* Fixed cross floor death where the player can be hit by the enemy AI on a different floor

* Fixed keypad bugs, where the secret door would not open after inputted the correct passcode or in rare cases door opens without inputting the correct passcode.

* Scary room added to the level

* Some packaging boxes that you can kick around.

* New menu screen font.

notes.title: Update V4 New graphics and direction system
notes.content: Update V4 includes new post processing stack from Unity, improving game graphics and performance, and a new direction system that prevents the player from getting lost or not knowing what to do. The new graphics make the game look more realistic, because it contains many new effects that were not available in V3.
